coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses. The ELF section table maps .text at VA 0x1343c80, file offset 0x1342c80, size 0x431c430; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. Tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship. This binary is PIE, so link-time VAs are load-base-relative at runtime.

got_slot.note: The slot lies in .got (VA range 0x576df80..0x5778d88). Its file bytes are zero because GOT slots are filled by the dynamic loader; the runtime value is NOT zero. The relocation record below gives the runtime value: load base + 0x4fe8fe0.

guard_cmp.note: AT&T operand order: cmp compares %rdx against the GOT slot. Equality falls through to the fast path; inequality jumps to the slow path at 0x514b1a8.

guard_target.note: A zero-returning function: endbr64, xor %eax,%eax, ret. This is why the fast path stores 0 without calling: calling the guard target and zero-extending its low byte would produce exactly 0.

incoming.note: Full .text scan for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on 0x514b170 finds none. Reach via indirect call, vtable slot or tail jump is not established and not claimed; the window's own protocol (rdi = container, rsi = out pointer) is what the entry bytes show.

indirect_call.note: At the call, rdi is the field object at [root+0x950], rsi is [root+0x30] + 0x40, rdx is the slot value itself, and rcx is the container root. Only the callee's low byte survives, via movzbl.

rule.composed: out = 0 without calling when the slot at [vtable+0x28] equals the runtime-resolved guard target (load base + 0x4fe8fe0); otherwise out = (indirect callee result) & 0xFF after calling the slot. Return value is 1 on every path. rbx is preserved and the stack is balanced (one push, one pop, no rsp adjustment).
rule.fast_path_reason: The guard target returns 0 (xor %eax,%eax; ret), so the fast path's stored 0 is exactly what the slow path would store if it called that function. The fast path is an elision of a known zero-returning implementation, not a different result.
rule.slot_chain: rcx = [rdi+0x788] (container root, same first hop as the neighboring container windows); field object = [rcx+0x950]; vtable head = [field object]; slot = [vtable head + 0x28]; slow-path argument = [rcx+0x30] + 0x40.
